# 1 Enoch Chapter 69 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 69:4 — Gadreel leads Eve astray — alternate Eden tradition

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he-led-astray-Eve" | Literal; Gadreel as the tempter in Gen 3 |
| LOGOS | "he led astray Eve" | Preserves the identification |
| PNEUMA | "He it was who led Eve astray" | Emphatic; makes the identification explicit |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The identification of Gadreel (not the serpent) as Eve's tempter is an alternate Eden tradition unique to the Enochic corpus. It should be preserved without softening or expansion.

**Status:** Full convergence. Theologically significant alternate tradition.

---

## 69:7 — writing with ink and paper as a sin

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he-instructed-mankind-in-writing-with-ink-and-paper, and-thereby-many-sinned" | Literal; writing itself causes sin |
| LOGOS | "he instructed mankind in writing with ink and paper, and thereby many sinned" | Agrees |
| PNEUMA | "He showed humanity how to write with ink and paper — and because of this, countless people have sinned" | 'Countless' for 'many'; slightly more emphatic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. 'Many sinned' is the Ge'ez text; 'countless' (PNEUMA) over-translates. The theological claim — that writing enabled the false swearing that the Watchers had introduced — is preserved clearly in all versions.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 69:9 — 'men were created exactly like the angels'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "men-were-created-exactly-like-the-angels, to-the-intent-that-they-should-continue-pure-and-righteous" | Literal; a high anthropology |
| LOGOS | "men were created exactly like the angels, to the intent that they should continue pure and righteous" | Agrees |
| PNEUMA | "Human beings were created to be exactly like the angels, meant to remain pure and righteous" | Slightly paraphrastic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. 'Created exactly like the angels' is one of the boldest anthropological claims in the Parables and must be preserved precisely. The purpose clause 'to the intent that they should continue pure and righteous' is the key: human mortality was not original but came through fallen-angel interference.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Highly significant anthropological claim.

---

## 69:24 — 'the name of that Son of Man had been revealed to them' — climactic moment

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-name-of-that-Son-of-Man-had-been-revealed-to-them" | Literal; the revelation of the name is the cause of joy |
| LOGOS | "the name of that Son of Man had been revealed to them" | Agrees |
| PNEUMA | "the name of that Son of Man had been revealed to them" | Agrees |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Full convergence. 'The name of that Son of Man' — all three translators agree. The revelation of the Son of Man's name is presented as the climax of the entire third Parable. 'That Son of Man' retains the definite demonstrative article pointing back to ch. 46.

**Status:** Full convergence. Theologically decisive moment.

---

## 69:25 — 'the sum of judgment was given to the Son of Man'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-sum-of-judgment-was-given-unto-the-Son-of-Man" | Literal; 'sum' = fullness, totality |
| LOGOS | "the sum of judgment was given to the Son of Man" | Agrees |
| PNEUMA | "The full authority of judgment was placed in the hands of the Son of Man" | 'Full authority' explicates 'sum'; 'in his hands' explicates 'given' |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. 'The sum of judgment' is the precise Ge'ez expression — a comprehensive transfer of judicial authority. PNEUMA's 'full authority' and 'placed in his hands' both add elements not in the text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Precise rendering of the judicial transfer.

---
